 Print IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 released for 4,256 vacancies, check direct download links and exam instructions IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 : The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 for Officer Scale I candidates on November 9, 2026. Applicants who registered for the recruitment examination can now access their preliminary examination call letters through the official website, ibps.in. The recruitment drive aims to fill 4,256 Officer Scale I vacancies across Regional Rural Banks. The IBPS RRB PO preliminary examination is scheduled for November 21 and 22, 2026. Candidates must download their hall tickets using their registration number or roll number and password or date of birth. The call letter contains essential information, including the examination centre, reporting time, examination schedule and entry instructions. IBPS RRB PO admit card download link The admit card download facility is active on the IBPS website. Candidates applying under the CRP RRB XV recruitment notification can access the document through the available login facility. IBPS will not send printed admit cards by post. Applicants must download and print their call letters independently. Candidates can use either of the following links: • Download IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026: Link 1 • Visit the IBPS official website: Link 2 IBPS RRB PO 2026: Recruitment details Particulars

 How to download the IBPS RRB PO hall ticket 
 Candidates can follow these steps to obtain their preliminary examination call letters: Step 1: Visit ibps.in. Step 2: Select the CRP RRBs section on the homepage. Step 3: Locate the Officer Scale I admit card link. Step 4: Enter the registration number or roll number. Step 5: Provide the password or date of birth. Step 6: Submit the login details. Step 7: Check the displayed admit card for examination details. Step 8: Download the PDF and print two copies on A4-size paper. Documents and examination day instructions Candidates must carry a printed copy of their admit card and a valid photo identity document. Accepted identification documents include Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Driving Licence and Voter ID. Applicants must affix a passport-size photograph in the designated space on the call letter. The photograph should match the one uploaded during registration. The signature and photograph must remain clearly visible. Candidates should reach their allotted examination centres at least 45 minutes before the scheduled examination time. Mobile phones, electronic gadgets and prohibited materials are not permitted inside the examination centre. The selection process includes the preliminary examination, mains examination, interview for Officer Scale I posts and document verification.
